tips: Type @ in your message to inject any vault note directly into your prompt.
Drag and drop an image or PDF onto the chat panel to attach it to your next message.
Paste an image from your clipboard straight into chat — BojuBot saves it and includes it automatically.
Switch to Read-only mode to let BojuBot browse your vault without making any changes to it.
Skills are parameterized slash commands stored as Markdown files in your vault — type / to browse them.
Click the session name in the toolbar to open the Sessions panel and jump to any past session.
Right-click a session in the Sessions panel to save it to your vault as a formatted Markdown transcript.
BojuBot can open notes, navigate headings, and trigger Obsidian commands on your behalf — no copy-pasting required.
Set a context file to give BojuBot standing instructions it reads at the start of every new session.
The vault tree depth setting controls how much of your folder structure BojuBot sees — set it to 0 to hide it entirely.
Skills registered as Ctrl+P commands let you fire a parameterized prompt from anywhere in Obsidian.
Session names are generated from your first message — rename them anytime from the Sessions panel's ⋯ menu.
Pin the sessions you keep coming back to: they stay at the top of the Sessions panel.
The command allowlist lets you pre-approve specific Obsidian commands so BojuBot can run them without asking each time.
Attach a URL to your message and BojuBot will fetch and read the page as part of your prompt.
BojuBot is aware of which notes you have open — it can see your active file and split-pane context automatically.
Full access mode lets BojuBot edit your vault freely. Use it when you want BojuBot to take the wheel on a writing session.
The autorun field in a skill file fires the skill immediately — no form, straight from the command palette.
Skills support a note parameter type — BojuBot receives the full content of a vault note as context for that skill.
Run the Reload skills command after adding or editing skill files to pick up changes without restarting Obsidian.
Mid-session permission upgrade: if BojuBot needs more access, you can grant it without starting a new session.
BojuBot can look up backlinks, outlinks, tags, or file lists from your live vault on demand — just ask.
Type /usage to see how much of your plan or quota is left — it runs locally and costs nothing.
Saving your Claude quota for other work? Switch Settings → Agent to Gemini (Antigravity CLI) for everyday notes.
claudeCodeTips: The ring gauge in the toolbar shows how full Claude's context window is — click it to compact the session and free up space.
Token stats appear below each response. Watch the cached count grow as a session warms up — cached tokens cost roughly 10× less.
BojuBot resumes sessions using Claude's built-in cache — the longer a conversation runs, the cheaper each turn gets.
